references.text: Moses gave this command to the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh to cross the Jordan ahead of the other tribes, as Joshua reminds them here.
The original agreement between Moses and the two and a half tribes that they would help with the conquest of Canaan before returning to their own land.
God's promise to give rest to his people, which is a central theme in Joshua's reminder.
The promise of rest in the promised land that Moses proclaimed to the people.
The fulfillment of the promise of rest, where Joshua sends the eastern tribes home after the land has been conquered.
The letter to the Hebrews interprets Joshua's rest as a foreshadowing of the final rest into which God's people will enter.
Moses is referred to as the servant of the Lord, the same title used in this text.
